about: Every frame of the scenery-heights board as its own PNG at native size (1280 x 720): the game's own pixels, one run of the real game per option and map (the Strike, seed 20261009, and Hold the bridge, seed 55; fog off, labels off, the sun fixed at 315 / 46). board.png is the sheet: 1:1 crops of these frames, the heights chart, the numbers table, the notes and the palette strip. The images are not committed (decision board-images): scripts/ui/boards/scenery_heights_board_shot.gd regenerates them.
